Christ brings all to knowledge of truth, calling to repentance, justifying through faith, and making renowned through sanctification, causing joy among the heavenly spirits, because God had mercy on Israel, not only the physical but also the spiritual, and the foundations of the earth, which are the ministers of the evangelical decrees, were established, and their sound went out everywhere, and certain sacred trumpets sounded, proclaiming the glory of the Savior to all and calling to knowledge of Christ those from circumcision and those who formerly worshiped the creation instead of the Creator, and Christ is the foundation and unshakeable base of all, bearing all and holding together the things that were falling, and we are all being built upon him, a spiritual house, being fitted together through the Spirit into a holy temple, a dwelling place for him, and he dwells in our hearts through faith, and the apostles and evangelists, who were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word, became a foundation for the faith, and we must follow their traditions to keep the faith straight and uncorrupted

You are Christ the Son of the living God; you are Peter and on this rock I will found my Church; the foundations of it are in the holy mountains; the apostles and evangelists are the holy mountains; the foundations of the earth are sounding; Moses was weak in speech; the law was not heard except by the Jews; those who preach Christ are sounding; their voice has gone out into all the earth and their words to the ends of the world; the foundations of the earth are again the mountains, the illustrious disciples, distinguished in work and word, known everywhere…
pass_b_english: Christ bringing all to the knowledge of the truth, calling to repentance, justifying through faith, and making renowned through sanctification, the heavenly spirits rejoiced because God had mercy on Israel, not only the physical but also the spiritual.
The foundations of the earth, which are the ministers of the evangelical decrees, were established, and their sound went out everywhere.

Certain sacred trumpets sounded, proclaiming the glory of the Savior to all and calling to knowledge of Christ those from circumcision and those who formerly worshiped the creation instead of the Creator.

Christ is the foundation and unshakeable base of all, bearing all and holding together the things that were falling, and we are all being built upon him, a spiritual house, being fitted together through the Spirit into a holy temple, a dwelling place for him.

He dwells in our hearts through faith, and the apostles and evangelists, who were eyewitnesses and ministers of the word, became a foundation for the faith, and we must follow their traditions to keep the faith straight and uncorrupted.
For Christ said to Peter, 'You are the Christ, the Son of the living God,' and 'You are Peter, and on this rock I will found my Church' (Matthew 16:16, 18).

The foundations of it are in the holy mountains (Psalm 87:1), and the holy mountains are to be understood as the holy apostles and evangelists, whose knowledge to those who come after them is like a foundation, preventing them from being shaken toward what is worthless in faith.

In contrast to Moses, who was weak in speech and slow of tongue, those who preach Christ sound a clear message, and their voice has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world (Psalm 19:4, Romans 10:18).
The foundations of the earth are sounding, and the illustrious disciples, known everywhere, are sounding the message of Christ.
